title: Interpolating between Optimal Transport and MMD using Sinkhorn Divergences
tldr_zh: 证明 debiased Sinkhorn divergence S_ε 对任意 ε>0 正定、凸、度量化弱收敛（ε→0 得 OT，ε→∞ 得 MMD），并给出百万点 GPU 实现
tldr_en: Proves the debiased Sinkhorn divergence is positive definite, convex and metrizes weak convergence for every epsilon, with a million-sample GPU implementation.
key_numbers: Theorem 1: S_eps >= 0, S_eps(a,b)=0 iff a=b, and S_eps(a_n,a)->0 iff a_n converges weakly, for compact X, Lipschitz C and positive universal Gibbs kernel exp(-C/eps)
Sinkhorn divergence costs 20-50x an MMD; implicit gradient formula (Eq. 26-27) gives 2-3x speedup over naive autograd (Fig. 3)
Gradient of a Sinkhorn loss with 100,000 samples per measure computed in seconds on GPU via KeOps (Sec. 3.3)
Symmetric Sinkhorn update (Eq. 25) for OT_eps(a,a) converges in about 3 iterations; 10-20 iterations suffice for eps >= 0.05 on unit square with C=||x-y|| (Sec. 3.1)
